title: 有馬記念の後に・耐え忍びし名将

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto dominates the year-end Grand Prix! She stands at the highest peak, surpassing both T.M. Opera O and the previous generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is not by coincidence, or so Grass Wonder believes. She relates Meisho Doto's win as inevitable, a flower coming into full bloom while hiding in the shadow of T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There is still a ways to go on her path to find true confidence. Nonetheless…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The racer who sought hope at rock bottom has emerged triumphant, becoming a beacon of hope for many.
